onset.explanation: The first qualifying finding is ICE 7/10 (Grade 1) at 09:10 on 02 Jun 2035 (Day +5), documented in signed note D02. The tremor in the same note is excluded from ICANS grading and onset (A11). Tocilizumab is treatment for CRS, so it is not a competing cause (A35). The ICE 10/10 baseline in D01 is from Day -6, before the observation window, so it is not used. D04 repeats the D02 line word for word, so it is copied forward and not new evidence. The record onset of 2035-06-02 is the same calendar day as the documented onset.

The documents support Grade 1, which equals the recorded maximum grade of 1.
